chunks.l2: Oṃ. Obeisance to Consciousness-Bhairava. You who shelter in consciousness-ground: take consciousness-state, wander not in vain. Proclaiming thus — Śiva, bent on grace, conquers for devotees.

chunks.c1:
## bhair-p01-v01 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Oṃ to Consciousness-Bhairava; shelter-takers take knowing, wander never vain; grace-bent Śiva conquers. Bhairava alone supreme nectar-one ablaze; sense-ring-swallowed all; venerated. Praised-praiser-praise though distinct undiffering; whatever formed by knowing becomes this, enduring. All melted, bliss-massed; Your principle's likeness in Your shape venerated. Letter-script outlines man; shape reveals varied-formed You, supreme self. Concept-free entered; we reflect what fancy never catches. Made, worded, offered: guru unfolded then heart entered. Mirroring praise of own-massed self; bonds outpoured in body-temple. Named powers conquer; splits gained, mouths skull-called. Objected limbs Yours to Sadāśiva; corpse-self Your seat.

*Rasa: maṅgala-bhakti of salute; bhakti-vīra of praised alone; adbhuta of undiffering three; bhakti-adbhuta of likeness venerated; adbhuta of revealed shape; vīra of concept-free reflecting; bhakti of arranged offerings; bhakti-vīra of temple praise; vīra of conquering powers; adbhuta of corpse-seat — The sthāyibhāva is love-address: salute, shelter, conquer. Invoking relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion-exultation: alone, nectar, ablaze, venerated. Praising relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: three named, none apart. Undifference relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion-wonder: melted, massed, likened, venerated. Likeness relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: outlined, massed, revealed. Revealing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: entered concept-free, reflected true. Reflecting relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion: made, worded, laid, entered. Offering relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion-exultation: praised mirroring, bonds poured, temple named. Praising relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: named, conquering, called. Conquering relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: limbed, Sadāśiva'd, corpse-seated. Seating relished.*

chunks.c1:
## bhair-p02-v11 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Light-bodied thought-power supreme goddess; hers the spreading of all. Bearing shown; world-opposed in me true-formed unopposed. Thread dissolved, sapless crowd; garland shown as-if to us. Look doubled at expelled nooses; gut-holding as-if appears speaking. Passionate cloth cast in highest heaven; bloodied hide head-borne told. Bared splitting by sword; world-taken heroes best. Fear-slayer lorded standing; shield-clash pointing us. Self-noosed, knowing-bodied, I count time; noose-held shown death's death. Difference-made hurled to unmake by own power; goad-held plain by supreme Bhairava. Bow-shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer pierced deer-like by power.

*Rasa: adbhuta of spreading goddess; vīra of unopposed-in-me; adbhuta of as-if showing; vīra of commanded seeing; adbhuta of cast cloth; vīra of best heroes; abhaya-vīra of fear-not; vīra of counted time; vīra of hurled distinction; vīra of deer-pierced cause — The sthāyibhāva is wonder: bodied, spread, led. Spreading relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: borne, opposed, unopposed. Pointing relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: dissolved, garlanded, as-if. Showing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: commanded twice, appeared. Commanding relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: cloth cast, hide told. Casting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: bared, splitting, best. Baring relished. The sthāyibhāva is fearless exultation: slayer standing, shield shown. Fearlessness relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: noosed, counted, shown. Counting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: hurled, goaded, plain. Hurling relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shown bow, pierced deer. Piercing relished.*
chunks.argmap:

chunks.c1:
## bhair-p03-v21 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Boon hand enacts glory-giving; principle-fixed glory-stainless ever. Fearless uprooting always shown; grace-cause-nature palmed. Māyā's shattered head borne by supreme waking shown. Essence-taken rest massed; skull-pretext commands. Wild-played instruments shown; triple-split sound heard standing. Parā-triple lovely imitated gods-outside, trident-pretext, always. Will-shown lower-three; thunder-made power six-spoked borne. World tamed all-held; staff-held Bhairava revealed to us. Mace-axe borne bindu-mirrored; split-bent pointed. Vision-differed assumed; waking-made proclaimed; abode everywhere.

*Rasa: vīra of enacted glory; vīra of uprooted fears; vīra of shattered Māyā; vīra of commanded rest; nāda-vīra of heard sound; vīra of mirrored gods; vīra of borne thunderbolt; vīra of tamed world; vīra of pointed splitting; vīra of proclaimed abode — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: enacted glory, unstained principle. Enacting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: uprooted fears, palmed grace. Uprooting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shattered, borne, shown. Shattering relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: taken, massed, commanded. Commanding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: played, split, heard, standing. Sounding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: lovely, mirrored, always. Mirroring relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shown low, borne high. Bearing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: tamed, held, revealed. Revealing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: borne, bent, pointed. Pointing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: assumed, proclaimed, everywhere. Proclaiming relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bhair-p03-v21 — argument map

chunks.c1:
## bhair-p04-v31 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Power-egg-middled saps all drunk always; within shown as-if. Pride-bond uprooters crested embodied lotus-shown, held. Seed-ground first mirrored waking-treasure; pomegranate show-played. Though Bhairava-shaped, rosary-held turns world within by letters. Bone-skull-ash-blood decked teaches world pure by Brahma-fullness. Self-pleased adverse bubbles; desire-burning brow-eye supreme-fire taught. Inward-aimed expanding shows unstained self in every state. Sky-cladness speaks self bare; how should Māyā's veil cover suns? All-destroyer shown from darkness-ground, gleaming-bodied. Brahma-full wearing Bhairava-form shown; differing yet freed.

*Rasa: pāna-vīra of drunk world-saps; vīra of held lotuses; vīra of mirrored seed; vīra of letter-turned world; raudra-vīra of gore-taught pure; raudra of brow-eye burning; vīra of aimed inward; adbhuta of bare-speaking sky; adbhuta of dark-shown destroyer; vīra-śānta of parted-freed — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: middled, drunk, within. Drinking relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: uprooted, lotus-shown, held. Holding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: seeded, mirrored, played. Mirroring relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shaped, held, turned. Turning relished. The sthāyibhāva is fierce exultation: decked gore, taught pure. Teaching relished. The sthāyibhāva is fierceness: jarred bubbles, burning brow. Burning relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: aimed, expanding, unstained. Aiming relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: bare spoken, veil questioned. Questioning relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: dark ground, gleaming shown. Showing relished. The sthāyibhāva is peaceful exultation: worn, shown, freed. Freeing relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bhair-p04-v31 — argument map

In Śakti-egg-fragment middle, world-juices — all I drink always. Shown by skull-cup-blood-pretext — this as-it-were my within.

chunks.c1:
## bhair-p05-v41 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Cremation-girt shown measuring midst; Bhairava am I. Alone-nectar-knower; worlds'-life shining heartward. Sound-bodied eightfold-ward outer retinue, finest-split led. All sealed by total-transmission; throng gladdened by fullness-shown. Noose-net loosed, distinction melted; shape seals knowing-wealth: seal called. Conquered ground excellent, draught-become dwelling clearly; stain known by truth-showing. Each moment knowing rises flashing below; glory-formed world known by rite-standers. Thus flashed in me always; rite-to-mantra-end complete effortlessly.

*Rasa: raudra-vīra of ghoul-girt am-I; amṛta-bhakti of heart-shining; adbhuta of eightfold retinue; mudrā-vīra of sealed all; mudrā-vīra of called seal; vīra of conquering draught; adbhuta of momently rising; śānta of sealed rite — The sthāyibhāva is fierce exultation: girt, shown, am. Being relished. The sthāyibhāva is nectar-devotion: alone, life, heartward. Shining relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: bodied sound, circled eight, led. Retinue relished. The sthāyibhāva is seal-exultation: sealed all, gladdened throng. Sealing relished. The sthāyibhāva is seal-exultation: loosed, melted, sealed, called. Calling relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: conquering, dwelling, known. Conquering relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: rising momently, flashing below. Rising relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: flashed in me, complete effortless. Sealing relished.*
